description: This source file defines a class `_NamedOptimizer` that wraps around a PyTorch optimizer, adding functionality to use fully qualified names (FQN) for parameters in distributed training setups. It manages optimizer state, parameter groups, and serialization, potentially supporting sharded tensors and Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) interfaces.
